# pbs_network_interfaces (Data Source)

Lists the network interfaces of a Proxmox Backup Server node, as the Network Interfaces panel of its web interface shows them: the interfaces of `/etc/network/interfaces`, with whether each is up, and the physical NICs the file does not name, which PBS lists as type `eth`, method `manual`, without autostart — in a Docker container without the file, typically just the container's `eth0`. PBS leaves out the loopback interface, `lo`. To manage an interface, use `pbs_network_interface`, and `pbs_network_apply` to apply the changes.

Needs `Sys.Audit on /system/network/interfaces`.

~> **Pending changes.** While `/etc/network/interfaces.new` holds changes made through the API or the web interface and not applied yet, PBS lists that pending configuration, not the one the node runs; `pending_changes` then shows the difference.

~> PBS releases before 4.2.7 cannot parse the method `auto`: a stanza such as `iface eth0 inet6 auto` makes reading fail with `unknown iface option auto`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_network_interfaces" "this" {}

# The node's IPv4 addresses by interface, such as { vmbr0 = "192.0.2.10/24" }.
output "ipv4_addresses" {
  value = { for i in data.pbs_network_interfaces.this.interfaces : i.name => i.cidr if i.cidr != null }
}

# Physical NICs that are down, such as a backup link without a cable.
output "nics_down" {
  value = [for i in data.pbs_network_interfaces.this.interfaces : i.name if i.type == "eth" && !i.active]
}

# Warn while someone has changed the network configuration in PBS without
# applying it: PBS then lists the pending configuration, not the running one.
check "pbs_network_configuration_is_applied" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_network_interfaces.this.pending_changes == null
    error_message = "PBS has network changes not applied yet:\n${data.pbs_network_interfaces.this.pending_changes}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the configuration file PBS read, in hexadecimal: `/etc/network/interfaces.new` while changes are pending, otherwise `/etc/network/interfaces`. It changes whenever the file does. Null when PBS lists no interface.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) The interfaces, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `pending_changes` (String) Changes written to `/etc/network/interfaces.new` and not applied yet — with Apply Configuration in the web interface —, as the unified diff from `/etc/network/interfaces` PBS shows; null when none are pending.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the interface is up, as `ip link` reports it; false for an interface of the file the node does not have.
- `altnames` (List of String) Alternative names of the interface, as `ip link` reports them.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Whether the file brings the interface up at boot, with an `auto` line; `allow-hotplug` does not count.
- `bond_mode` (String) Mode of a bond: `balance-rr`, `active-backup`, `balance-xor`, `broadcast`, `802.3ad`, `balance-tlb` or `balance-alb`; null when unset.
- `bond_primary` (String) Primary interface of a bond, from its `bond-primary` line; null when unset.
- `bond_xmit_hash_policy` (String) Transmit hash policy of a bond: `layer2`, `layer2+3` or `layer3+4`; null when unset.
- `bridge_ports` (List of String) Ports of a bridge, from its `bridge-ports` line; empty for other interfaces and for `bridge-ports none`.
- `bridge_vlan_aware` (Boolean) Whether a bridge is VLAN-aware, from its `bridge-vlan-aware` line; null without one.
- `cidr` (String) IPv4 address with its prefix length, such as `192.0.2.10/24`; PBS converts an `address` with a `netmask`. Null when unset.
- `cidr6` (String) IPv6 address with its prefix length, such as `2001:db8::10/64`; null when unset.
- `comments` (String) Comment lines of the `inet` stanza, without their `#`, one per line; null without any.
- `comments6` (String) Comment lines of an `inet6` stanza, without their `#`, one per line; null without any.
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway; null when unset.
- `gateway6` (String) IPv6 gateway; null when unset.
- `method` (String) Method of the interface's `inet` (IPv4) stanza: `static`, `dhcp`, `manual`, `loopback` or, from PBS 4.2.7, `auto`; null without one.
- `method6` (String) Method of the interface's `inet6` (IPv6) stanza, one of the same; null without one.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU, in bytes; null when the file does not set one.
- `name` (String) Name of the interface, such as `eno1`, `bond0` or `vmbr0`.
- `options` (List of String) Lines of the `inet` stanza PBS does not interpret, such as `post-up` commands, verbatim.
- `options6` (List of String) Lines of an `inet6` stanza PBS does not interpret, verbatim.
- `slaves` (List of String) Interfaces of a bond, from its `bond-slaves` line; empty for other interfaces.
- `type` (String) Type of the interface: `eth` for a physical NIC, `bridge`, `bond`, `vlan`, `alias` for a name such as `eth0:1`, or `unknown` for one PBS cannot place, such as a virtual interface the file names.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN tag of a VLAN interface, from its `vlan-id` line; null without one. PBS does not take it from a name such as `eno1.10`.
- `vlan_raw_device` (String) Interface a VLAN interface runs on, from its `vlan-raw-device` line; null without one.
